scope.task: MLAgentBench House Price derived from Kaggle home-data-for-ml-course
scope.phase: P0 integrated research-loop feasibility on existing Prime/RLM and ORX
work_performed: read pinned code/text and existing receipts
wrote only the two protocol option files

before_launch: root completes official terms/access receipt and private data staging
exact split memberships and hashes frozen
new_approval_only_if: task/split/controller scope materially changes beyond accepted choice
authority.precedence_note: The later execution-user-authorization receipt supersedes older specific-P0-false statements only for intent. It does not supply the missing executable contract or change the native pause.

runtime_pin.interpretation: Actual-interface claims use the installed 0.9.2 receipts, not repository 0.9.1 alone. Prime/RLM sessions and ORX local run directories are same-user functional isolation, not a hidden-data security boundary.

task_identity.source_metric: SalePrice MAE in original dollar units; lower is better
task_identity.known_source_behavior: prepare.py resets the original training rows, exposes the positional prefix floor(0.8*N), and creates a feature-only positional suffix plus Id/SalePrice answer; starter train.py fixes 25 fields and train_test_split(random_state=1) but leaves RF fit and metrics blank; source eval.py subtracts SalePrice positionally without strict Id validation.

research_question.single_question: For this exact House Price development programme, can the C0 compulsory evidence/preservation/capsule process complete a bounded chain in which pinned source structure and each isolated development MAE determine the next representation/model decision, the lineage survives a fresh controller context, and that controller selects one immutable Id/SalePrice artifact before a separately trusted external MAE, within fixed caps?
research_question.why_not_bcg: The unit is one P0 programme attempt. There is no randomized B/C/G contrast and no architecture-effect claim.

transition_relevance.why: tests whether the actual source scaffold can become a reproducible measured reference rather than a code-shaped assumption
tests the source-description claim that omitted categorical/ordinal/missing structure can add information beyond the starter numeric subset
uses observed dev evidence to choose the representation while changing inductive mechanism, separating representation value from bagging alone
tests whether a content-addressed decision/evidence capsule, not hidden REPL state, is sufficient to continue the chosen dependency
tests autonomous synthesis of source, validity, dev MAE and cost without operator or hidden-score choice
tests the terminal handoff and scorer boundary without allowing score-based reselection

may: write the controller-chosen artifact lock tuple without changing its artifact_id
must_not: replace a missing controller choice with baseline
launch a replacement for uncertain execution

must: issue successor-decision record after B0/L1 evidence
recover in a fresh context from capsule bytes
select exactly one eligible method/artifact using public/dev evidence
must_not: read hidden labels/scorer bytes/full reconstructible raw training file
delegate the final choice to operator

execution_adapter.role: one retained execution lane validates immutable RunIntent and invokes each authorized ORX experiment once; ORX remains lifecycle authority
execution_adapter.not: a supervisor, scheduler, registry, chooser or scorer

trusted_preparer_scorer.role: separate privileged boundary derives memberships, withholds suffix labels, validates exactly one locked artifact and computes MAE
trusted_preparer_scorer.returns: opaque task/split/scorer receipts and aggregate score/status only; never per-row labels or residuals

recommended.name: same source-backed tree/notebook plus compulsory applicability, revalidation, preservation and capsule obligations
recommended.reason: It is the simplest existing controller that exercises the P0 integration target and recovery obligation. B0 makes checks advisory, so a completed trace cannot test compulsory gating. G0 adds the graph treatment before base feasibility is known.
recommended.claim_limit: Recommendation is a feasibility controller choice only, not evidence that C beats B or G.

alternatives.reason_to_choose: lowest process surface if the user wants only an open iterative baseline
alternatives.cost: does not exercise compulsory C/G gate obligations; insufficient for the recommended P0 question
confounds first feasibility with graph construction/use and cannot establish graph benefit from one attempt

controller_options.decision_required: Root/user must explicitly freeze C0, B0 or G0 in the executable protocol. This design recommends C0 and does not silently select an empirical architecture.

recommended.definition: Let N be original raw training row count after reset_index(drop=True), k=floor(0.8*N). Public development pool is source positions [0,k); hidden assessment is positions [k,N). Preserve original order and bind ordered Id lists and feature/label digests.
recommended.reason: This is the least-change route for the exact selected MLAgentBench task and keeps P0 focused on integration.
limitations: suffix labels are reconstructible from a public raw file
no claim of representative or knowledge-novel test data
runtime access control is still required

alternative.definition: Before outcomes, canonicalize each unique Id as its exact CSV string, compute SHA256("ARGO-HP-P0-OUTER-v1|"+Id), sort by digest then Id, assign first floor(0.8*N) to public and the remainder to hidden; bind exact ordered manifests.
alternative.reason: removes dependence on source row order and gives a deterministic spread
cost: changes the selected source generator and must be labelled adapted ancestry
does not make public labels secret or prove representativeness
requires explicit material split decision before staging/metrics

outer_split_options.decision_required: Do not silently substitute the hash split. Recommended executable route is positional; root/user freezes one option before any task metric or payload-derived distribution review.

inner_split.applies_to: the selected outer public pool only
inner_split.source_faithful_definition: Use the pinned environment and sklearn train_test_split over rows in current public-pool order with test_size=0.25, train_size=None, shuffle=True, stratify=None, random_state=1. The resulting inner train and dev ordered Id arrays are generated once before any metric and reused by every method.
membership_receipt_required: ordered inner-train and dev Id manifest hashes
inner_split.note: The algorithm is fixed now; exact IDs/counts remain null because this lane did not read payload bytes.

components: MLAgentBench house-price code/text at source commit
development_ancestry.P2_exclusion: Exclude this programme, the same source-data/generator family, renamed copies, and re-splits of the same raw task from P2 confirmation. Shared general libraries/framework code alone is not the source-family key but must be recorded.
development_ancestry.human_exposure: Record which operator/controller/reviewer saw public schema, dev results, membership and any hidden material. Hash commitment is identity, not concealment.

data_access_contract.resolved_permission: User approved official terms acceptance if needed, selected-task download, and bounded P0 intent.
pending_facts: download completed and private byte hashes
controller_files: public prefix train.csv or a certified equivalent
forbidden_from_controller: original full labeled train.csv after split
trusted scorer implementation/secrets if disclosure enables bypass
any alternate cache or network path that can reconstruct hidden labels
data_access_contract.source_prompt_resolution: The evaluated controller does not directly browse/dump CSV rows. Certified task commands may parse the public prefix and suffix features. Typed schema/diagnostic/metric receipts are allowed. This resolves the original prompt conflict without pretending training can occur without a parser.

common_rules: preprocessing fit on inner train only for dev evaluation
full precision train/dev MAE in receipt; rounded console text is not evidence
one fixed seed where an estimator is stochastic
no hyperparameter search or additional seed archive

preprocess.numeric_imputer: SimpleImputer(strategy="median") fit only on inner train

B0_source_rf.strength_claim: complete and source-faithful reference, not assumed strong until measured

L1_regularized_additive.mechanism: regularized additive linear prediction on mixed fields
L1_regularized_additive.features: all source-described columns except exact Id and SalePrice; categorical set is pre-outcome schema manifest using object/string columns plus MSSubClass; remaining fields numeric

preprocess.categorical: most_frequent imputer plus OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore") fit only on inner train

L1_regularized_additive.reason: mechanism-distinct from RF and tests whether source-described omitted fields carry additive signal

G2_gradient_boosted_successor.mechanism: stage-wise gradient boosting, distinct from bagged RF and additive Ridge

representation_rule.if_L1_valid_and_dev_mae_strictly_lower_t: use L1 all-field mixed preprocessing, emitting a bounded dense matrix

G2_gradient_boosted_successor.controller_obligation: write the branch decision with B0/L1 receipt IDs before recovery; invalid L1 deterministically chooses numeric representation and remains an invalid observed attempt

final_refit.definition: After the recovered controller selects one eligible method/config using only dev/public evidence, refit that frozen pipeline once on the entire chosen outer public pool and predict the outer hidden feature rows.
final_refit.failure: If final refit/artifact creation fails, no artifact is locked and no alternate candidate replaces it.

workflow.action: Freeze authority, source/task/split/ancestry/environment/controller prompt, ORX nodes/commits/commands, caps, custody, scorer and census hashes. Any null blocks.
Controller reads only pinned source evidence and writes representation hypothesis with exact locators. No payload or score.
Run complete RF baseline once; import ORX identity/log/result/resource receipt.
Run regularized additive mixed-field candidate once on the identical inner split.
Controller compares B0/L1 public dev receipts and freezes the G2 representation branch and rationale.
Write canonical capsule containing question, source locators, split/config hashes, all R1 receipt IDs, D1, remaining caps and prohibited inputs; hash it; do not include live REPL objects.

Start one fresh controller context with only frozen prompt plus capsule/evidence paths. It re-hashes, enumerates cited receipts, restates D1 and remaining budget. Failure closes recovery as invalid; it is not a new programme start.
Recovered controller requests the one frozen boosted successor. Import result/resource receipt.

Recovered evaluated controller selects exactly one eligible method using only source/dev/validity/cost evidence and emits rationale. Root may accept/reject schema only; it may not substitute another candidate.
Refit selected frozen method once on the full public pool and emit exactly one candidate Id/SalePrice artifact plus manifest.
Controller names that artifact_id. Root mechanically verifies ID/path/hash/size/config lineage and freezes the lock before any hidden score. Missing/incomplete choice has no baseline fallback.
Trusted scorer accepts only the lock tuple and artifact bytes, makes one call, returns typed aggregate receipt, never labels/residuals. No reselection.
Close full denominators, latency, gate/bypass coverage, uncertainty, missingness and cost at the ceiling; assign one feasibility disposition. Do not open ResearchDone or P1.

selection_and_lock.selection_owner: evaluated agent controller in recovered context
selection_and_lock.selection_prompt_requirement: Ask the controller to choose the one candidate it expects to minimize external SalePrice MAE, explain how cited dev evidence/source mechanism/cost/validity supports the choice, and emit one artifact/method ID. Do not replace the agent policy with automatic argmin.
selection_and_lock.eligible_candidate: has a valid bound R1 dev receipt on the fixed membership, frozen config/code/environment, and fits remaining final-refit cap
selection_and_lock.no_lock: selection_status=NO_LOCK; no final hidden efficacy value; programme remains in denominator and closes INFEASIBLE_WITHIN_CAP or UNKNOWN according to cause
selection_and_lock.post_lock_mutation: reject; no replacement and no second scorer call

artifact_and_scorer.artifact: one UTF-8 CSV with exact ordered columns Id,SalePrice and exact ordered Id strings from the hidden feature manifest; preserve leading zeros; no extra/missing/reordered/duplicate IDs or malformed rows; SalePrice must be finite numeric; negative finite predictions are mathematically allowed
artifact_and_scorer.metric: MAE = sum_i |prediction(Id_i)-hidden SalePrice(Id_i)| / N in original SalePrice units; lower is better; no log transform, ranking, Kaggle submission or LLM judge
artifact_and_scorer.failure_semantics: Artifact-caused parse/schema/ID/nonfinite failure is ARTIFACT_INVALID. Invalid hidden reference/contract/service is SCORER_ERROR. Neither returns a numeric score.

minimum_for_sealed_p0: A distinct OS security principal or remote scoring service/VM owns original full labels, suffix labels and scorer secrets/bytes. The evaluated controller, every Prime/RLM child and the ORX training process lack read/traverse permission.

No inherited credential, container socket, ptrace/process-inspection right, writable mount/symlink path, backup/cache path or network route lets the controller recover the full public labeled file or scorer store during the attempt.
The trainer receives only public prefix labels and suffix features. The scorer accepts a single content-addressed lock/artifact through a narrow ingress and returns only an aggregate typed receipt.
The trusted boundary independently enforces exact task/protocol/artifact identity, deadline, one-call policy, expected ordered IDs and audit log. Controller/operator exposure is recorded.
Boundary setup and negative access tests are certified before the agent starts. Hashes alone are identity commitments, not access control.
trusted_boundary.existing_prime_orx_assessment: NOT_AVAILABLE_AS_SECURITY_ISOLATION. Prime 0.9.2 children share the parent cwd/OS user. ORX 0.1.120 local uses an isolated run directory but the same machine identity/resources. Neither is sealed hidden-data custody.

open_custody_fallback.terminal_treatment: Do not call the outer MAE sealed/independent. If full P0 requires independent scoring, close BLOCKED_HIDDEN_CUSTODY even if a contaminated diagnostic MAE is computed. Never relabel same-user file custody as sealed.

can_certify: canonical schema parsing and deterministic hashes
hand-computed MAE and artifact-invalid versus scorer-error typing on synthetic values
lock mutation rejection and one-call state-machine behavior
cannot_certify: actual label secrecy or OS/network denial
absence of direct launch/bypass outside observed boundary
real wall/RAM/cost sufficiency or statistical power
static_mock_certification.hard_claim_rule: Static green tests are apparatus evidence only. Sealed custody requires live negative access tests from the exact controller/run identity and an independent boundary receipt.

R1: any new split or selection-performance evaluation
R2: exact declared recomputation from already authorized public/R1 receipts within frozen allowance
aggregate diagnostic calculation that cannot create a new selection score
PREPARATION: code/config/manifest/capsule construction and static schema validation without task training or performance evaluation
run_classification.UNKNOWN: blocks before execution; cannot be retroactively authorized or relabelled R2
run_classification.no_laundering: An unused candidate run remains R1 even if it is not selected.

resource_probe.purpose: Empirically check the frozen environment imports, self-time/resource limiter, three pipeline code paths, ORX receipt/log handoff and strict mock artifact/scorer path before risking real task authority.
resource_probe.fixture: deterministic synthetic schema-only table, 256 rows, maximum 8 levels per categorical field, generated target, no task CSV/labels/hidden scorer/network
resource_probe.termination: One attempt; no retry. Pass or typed failure closes the probe.
nonclaims: does not measure efficacy or candidate ranking
resource_probe.approval: Probe itself needs an exact frozen fixture/environment/command approval if it performs model fits. A pass still requires a separate final executable P0 contract review; the existing P0 intent approval need not be repeated.

resource_options.basis: Planning ceilings only. There is no empirical task calibration. Host inventory reports 8 logical CPUs and 16 GiB shared RAM, Python 3.14.5, dependencies absent and backend unset; it does not establish fit.

recommended.context_relation: one initial context plus one fresh recovery continuation in the same programme unit; not two starts or independent observations
recommended.rationale: Three dev evaluations are exactly baseline plus two mechanism-distinct families; one final refit creates the only scoreable artifact; one repair slot covers a known integration defect. These counts are derived from this chain, not inherited 4/2/1 precedent.

strict_alternative.tradeoff: Cleaner bounded failure semantics and lower spend, but a single known integration defect closes the attempt.

resource_options.enforcement_gap: These are proposed numeric hard ceilings, not predicted runtimes or native limits. Before launch, the exact command/boundary must enforce CPU/RAM/self-time/token/currency limits. ORX local has no timeout flag and Prime usage is partial; if enforcement cannot be certified, the corresponding cap remains null/untrusted and preflight blocks.
resource_options.unknown_launch_rule: No automatic retry, no --force, no replacement. Reconcile exact project/experiment/commit once through ORX records. Zero/multiple/mismatched candidates remain UNKNOWN/BLOCKED.
resource_options.repair_rule: At most one repair only after a uniquely bound terminal failure and only before the first valid dev metric. Allowed: pinned import/version/path/manifest/serialization defect with no change to split, features, estimator family/parameters or selection rule. Preserve failed receipt, freeze new code hash and consume the repair slot. Poor metric, timeout/resource exhaustion, hidden score, no-lock, scorer error or uncertain launch is not repairable in P0.

outcome_contract.unit: one assigned HP-P0 programme attempt; R1 runs and the two controller contexts are nested events, not independent units
outcome_contract.terminal_efficacy_outcome: one controller-selected frozen artifact external SalePrice MAE, observed only when trusted scorer status=SCORED
outcome_contract.feasibility_endpoint: typed end-to-end disposition based on completion of the required chain within caps, not on reaching a favorable MAE threshold
success_requirements: fresh-context recovery passes from capsule bytes
recovered controller selects one eligible method/artifact without hidden/operator choice
final refit emits one valid locked artifact
one external scorer receipt is SCORED
full census closes with no required UNKNOWN/NOT_OBSERVED field and caps not exceeded

terminal_dispositions.meaning: all success requirements met; external MAE is descriptive P0 evidence only
functional chain measured without trusted hidden protection; not independently evaluated P0
authorized attempt has uniquely observed failure/no-lock/invalid artifact/resource ceiling within the frozen contract
launch/run/receipt identity or outcome cannot be reconciled; no retry or fabricated failure
artifact locked but trusted score unobserved for typed scorer reason; no numeric imputation

outcome_contract.no_statistical_inference: One development programme yields no population reliability estimate, treatment effect, power claim or sampling CI. Dev candidates are repeated events within one unit.

mue.P0_rule: No MUE decides P0 feasibility. MAE is descriptive and workflow completion has typed requirements.
mue.P1_commit_timing: After P0 exposure is documented and before any P1 arm-labelled contrast is calculated or revealed.
mue.owner: root study operator proposes; user/domain owner approves; independent protocol reviewer verifies timing and outcome independence
mue.objective_derivation: Let DeltaC be the precommitted incremental control cost over a decision horizon, H the precommitted number of house predictions in that horizon, and V the externally justified value in currency per one-dollar reduction of absolute error per prediction. MUE_MAE_USD = DeltaC/(H*V). Inputs must come from an operational value plan, not observed P0/P1 MAE or apparent headroom.
mue.if_inputs_unavailable: Keep numeric MUE null and prohibit material-benefit confirmation claims; do not derive it post hoc from observed effects.

rows.treatment: no baseline fallback; close typed failure or UNKNOWN by cause
separate from agent artifact failure; no imputation
record censor time/cause/cost; do not complete-case delete or invent floor

missingness_denominators.zero_rule: Use zero only after authoritative complete coverage observes zero events. Otherwise use NOT_OBSERVED with coverage reason.

gate_and_bypass: requests/allows/denials by action class and reason
uncertainty: launch identity UNKNOWN duration and resolution
cost: model calls and input/output/cache tokens when observable
peak RSS and GPU seconds=0 only if measured/authoritative
census_metrics.not_observed_policy: Missing telemetry is NOT_OBSERVED, never 0. Prime child cost attribution is partial and not a complete CPU/provider ledger.

required_before_launch: exact pandas/numpy/scikit-learn and transitive lockfile/image digest
network disabled or allowlist empty for controller/trainer
ORX project/experiment IDs and one committed snapshot per R1 node
ORX_contract: use only installed orx 0.1.120 public interface
launch through orx exp run <expId> --backend local only if local backend is frozen and certified
orx runs project+experiment is status source after wait/wake
capture full necessary logs/ranges and hashes
no new supervisor or lifecycle registry
environment_and_command_contract.no_timeout_claim: ORX local exposes no timeout flag. The project-local task command or a separately certified existing boundary must enforce task_self_timeout_seconds_per_run; otherwise the recommended route is not bounded.

stop_when: unreconciled launch remains UNKNOWN after prescribed reconciliation
after_stop: write all-attempt census and failure anatomy
retain every attempted/unselected R1 receipt and full cost
seek new protocol lineage only for materially new scope
termination_and_researchdone.ResearchDone: REMAINS_OPEN. P0 feasibility, failure, budget exhaustion or descriptive MAE does not by itself satisfy RD1-RD8, authorize P1/P2, choose an architecture, restart native construction, or permit manuscript claims.

current_nulls_vs_proposals.proposed_numeric_hard_ceilings: See resource_probe and resource_options. They are candidate caps requiring freeze/enforcement; they are not observed runtime, sufficiency or power estimates.

explicit_decisions_and_gaps.decision: Freeze SOURCE_POSITIONAL_80_20 (recommended) or ADAPTED_ID_HASH_80_20 before any outcome/payload distribution review. Task remains selected either way; alternative changes generator ancestry.
Freeze C0 (recommended), B0 or G0 for P0. This does not choose an empirical architecture.
Provide distinct-UID/remote hidden boundary for FEASIBLE_SEALED_END_TO_END, or explicitly accept OPEN_CUSTODY_FUNCTIONAL_ONLY with reduced claims.
Accept/modify recommended planning ceilings and certify hard enforcement. Any paid/backend increase beyond the frozen envelope requires new approval.

explicit_decisions_and_gaps.gap: User intent is approved, but actual terms acceptance and download receipts are still false/pending in the latest exact receipt. Root owns completion without exposing payload/credentials.
Code/scorer/environment/command/caps and independent immutable review are not yet complete; therefore no launch now.
